basics.name: Jason Taylor
basics.label: Principal Advanced Support Engineer
basics.summary: Experienced IT Professional with a background in software development, DevOps, System Administration and Technical Support, transitioning into cybersecurity. Currently completed an MS in Computer Science with a concentration in cybersecurity, with hands-on experience building deep learning models for malware detection. Seeking to leverage many years of IT expertise in support of a cybersecurity-focused role.

work.name: Delinea
highlights: Handle the most complex and escalated customer cases across Delinea's DevOps Secrets Vault, Account Lifecycle Manager, and Identity Threat Protection SaaS products, owning each issue from initial diagnosis through resolution, and coordinating with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to drive outcomes for enterprise customers.
Consistently maintain a 4.8/5.0 CSAT score across escalated enterprise cases, reflecting strong technical resolution quality and customer communication.

Investigate and resolve complex technical failures including OIDC authentication issues, API integration errors, and log analysis across cloud and on-prem environments, escalating internally to Engineering when needed.

Serve as Embedded Support Engineer for Identity Threat Protection, co-located with the development team to provide customer-centric insights, accelerate root-cause analysis, and feed product-quality improvements.

Participate in an internal AI innovation workgroup exploring AI-driven solutions to improve support efficiency and customer experience, evaluating LLM-based tools for case prioritization, case summarization, knowledge retrieval, and triage automation.

Act as Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) coach for the support team, mentoring engineers on KCS methodology, authoring public tutorials and knowledge base articles, and building the foundational content that reduces case volume and improves self-service.

Onboard and train new support engineers on Delinea's DevOps Secrets Vault and Account Lifecycle Manager product lines, and partner with Sales Engineers on proof-of-concept configurations that support deal advancement.

work.name: Oracle
highlights: Migrated 1,200 internally hosted EPM Cloud demo environments to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) using Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, custom Ansible playbooks, and GitLab for source control.
Migrated Bash scripts used for EPM lifecycle management to Ansible playbooks, reducing the number of scripts by 60% and improving EPM Cloud demo environment management.
Implemented linting, unit testing, and coding standard adherence for all scripts and Ansible playbooks used in OCI, improving code quality and reducing errors.

Built Python and Bash tools using EPM Automate and EPM REST APIs that cut sales consultants' demo prep work by 50%, including tools to load custom demo content, refresh demo environments to a clean state, and restart services.

Created Ansible playbooks used by Oracle's demo operations team to manage EPM demo environments in OCI, including tasks to start/stop services, upgrade environments, and perform maintenance and diagnostic health checks.

Created custom Python scripts to install and maintain monthly upgrades for the EPM Chatbot, installing required files and configuring Oracle's Mobile Hub and Digital Assistant, deployed and maintained via a GitLab CI/CD pipeline.

work.name: Hyperion Solutions
highlights: Managed build infrastructure for the demo build team; created PowerShell, VBScript, and WSH automation to support sales consultants in demonstrating Hyperion environments and closing software deals.

Created custom applications and scripts with PowerShell, visual basic script, and Windows Script Host to be used by sales consultants which helped showcase the Hyperion demo environments and sell more software.
Coordinated migration of on-premises demo environments to a third-party hosted model, including VM configuration and a library of demo scenarios for field sales use.

work.name: Canberra Industries
highlights: Developed and tested a custom application to determine the quality of Helium-3 detectors, built in Visual Basic 6 with a rich GUI for data acquisition, quality assurance, and custom reporting.
Developed, modified, and tested a custom Inline Monitoring System covering data acquisition/setup, reporting, and other utilities, implementing custom algorithms for calibration and sample assay.
Maintained and enhanced Canberra's flagship Genie 2000 Gamma Ray Spectroscopy Software using C and C++ to ensure stability, performance, and feature continuity.
